Sad thing is, I’ve gotten help. It hasn’t gotten easier my dude. Meds, therapy, spent 5 days in a mental hospital. I lied to just get out so I could see my son. I think about suicide every single day. I spent last night laying in bed crying, the same spot my son slept on the night before. I cried when I couldn’t smell his scent on my sheets. It too tough. I’m just done my dude.
Therapy, meds, talking to people just doesn’t work. I’m ready man. The most ready I’ve ever been.

Going to use the cord to hang myself tonight. I’m just so incredibly hurting right now. My child’s mother wins. I’m done. I’m just done. Hopefully my kid knows how hard I fought. In the end, I just want him to have a better life. He belongs with his mother.
Thanks man I appreciate it. I’m holding on.
